commentary: That's it from all of us here. Do join us tomorrow for more Asia Cup action. Till then it's bye bye and ta ta.

Ateeq Iqbal to Hasaranga, FOUR, Sri Lanka win. It's a half-volley on middle, Hasaranga gets forward and drills it straight down the ground, the batters don't even bother to run. A fine cameo from Hasaranga and Sri Lanka have done it with 7 balls to spare
Ateeq Iqbal to Hasaranga, FOUR, scores level. A back of a length delivery on off, Hasaranga gets forward and lofts, wide of cover and easily beats mid-off to his left, runs away
Ateeq Iqbal to Hasaranga, 2 runs, good length on leg-stump, turned to deep backward square-leg and Shanaka runs hard to come back for two
Ateeq Iqbal to Hasaranga, 2 runs, full outside off, Hasaranga gets forward to drive, the thick outside-edge goes wide of backward point and it's an easy two
Ateeq Iqbal to Hasaranga, no run, back of a length on off, Hasaranga mistimes the cross-batted shot, dribbles to cover
